correctness.rationale: The necessary-and-sufficient connected initial-set characterization is established by hub separation, two white cycle-neighbor obstruction, and at-most-one-unseeded-arm obstruction. The sharp root criterion follows from a quadratic discriminant and Newton inequalities. A standalone separate graph-set enumerator checked 170 graphs and 1,301,942 nonempty subsets, not substituted for the general proof.

value.rationale: The all-cardinality enumeration naturally covers all one-hub cycle spiders with arbitrary many attached paths and their lengths, extending structural understanding from trees to unicyclic graphs. The at-most-one-unseeded-arm principle and 2t minimum-set multiplicity are nontrivial across arbitrary arm counts. In a natural exactly-one-subdivided-arm subfamily, a sharp t=4 transition from nonreal to real zeros adds a polynomial-geometry phenomenon not determined by scalar forcing numbers.
